# adk — agents-devkit

> A single-repo, multi-agent skill kit for code/docs/investigations.
> 10 polymorphic skills + 10 MCPs + 9 subagents, installed via `./install.sh` to
> Claude Code / Cursor / Codex CLI / Junie at user level. No marketplace.

## Read first

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): how to interpret any user prompt — verb classification, intent → skill routing, composite-intent chains.
- [shared/constitution.md](./shared/constitution.md): universal hard rules (no force-push, no auto-merge, read-only against prod systems).
- [shared/advisor.md](./shared/advisor.md): the plan→clarify→present→defer→execute→validate→report wrapper every skill composes.
- [shared/question-first.md](./shared/question-first.md): mandatory 0–3 question phase before any execution. Each Q&A is training data.

## Skills

- [skills/adk-implement/SKILL.md](./skills/adk-implement/SKILL.md): write code from any input (Jira / GH issue / Slack / TDD / Confluence / freeform). Specialized sub-flows for Jira (most common) and GH issues.
- [skills/adk-review/SKILL.md](./skills/adk-review/SKILL.md): lightweight review of any target (PR URL; local working tree; markdown doc; comment thread; whole-repo audit). For deep PR review, use adk-pr-review.
- [skills/adk-pr-review/SKILL.md](./skills/adk-pr-review/SKILL.md): heavyweight PR review with worktree + LanceDB embeddings + SCIP + feature-flow tracing. GitHub + Bitbucket Cloud only. Global skill — isolates to `~/.agents-devkit/pr-reviews/<repo>_pr-<n>/`. Requires ollama + Python deps (lancedb, requests). Optional scip-typescript / scip-python / scip-go / scip-java for symbol resolution. Parallel-safe: per-repo clone-lock briefly serialises git ops; per-PR lock prevents same-PR races.
- [skills/adk-pr-reviews/SKILL.md](./skills/adk-pr-reviews/SKILL.md): batch driver over /adk-pr-review. Reads a CSV of PR URLs from `~/.agents-devkit/pr-reviews/queue.csv` (or arg). Runs N reviews concurrently. Skips rows where PR is merged or `state.json.last_reviewed_head_oid == current head_oid` (unless `re_review_required`). Spawns `claude -p` per non-skipped row. Designed for periodic / cron execution.
- [skills/adk-investigate/SKILL.md](./skills/adk-investigate/SKILL.md): query 3P data (Datadog / Mixpanel / Statsig / Snowflake / Looker / Atlassian / Slack). Sub-flows: incident, rca, experiment, datadog, mixpanel, statsig, snowflake, looker.
- [skills/adk-document/SKILL.md](./skills/adk-document/SKILL.md): generate any markdown artifact (runbook / ADR / RCA / PR body / commit msg / changelog / diagram / readme / migration guide / api reference / experiment report / incident summary / handoff / onboarding / design doc).
- [skills/adk-sync/SKILL.md](./skills/adk-sync/SKILL.md): bidirectional 3P bridge — read remote as markdown OR push markdown to Confluence / Jira-desc / Jira-comment / GDoc / GH PR body / GH issue comment / Slack.
- [skills/adk-setup/SKILL.md](./skills/adk-setup/SKILL.md): bootstrap `~/.config/adk/overrides.yaml`; --enrich populates auto-discovered metadata from MCPs; --check verifies env + agents + MCPs.
- [skills/adk-improve/SKILL.md](./skills/adk-improve/SKILL.md): self-improvement loop. Reads `~/.config/adk/learning/decisions.jsonl` → proposes default updates to overrides.yaml → user confirms → rotates the log.
- [skills/adk-explain/SKILL.md](./skills/adk-explain/SKILL.md): advisor agent. Teaches the user how to choose without picking. Hand-off target from any skill when the user expresses uncertainty.

## MCPs (env-var-driven; zero tokens in JSON)

- [mcp/adk-mcp-github.json](./mcp/adk-mcp-github.json) — `GITHUB_TOKEN_CRED`.
- [mcp/adk-mcp-bitbucket.json](./mcp/adk-mcp-bitbucket.json) — `BITBUCKET_TOKEN_CRED` (or `BITBUCKET_USERNAME` + `BITBUCKET_APP_PASSWORD`).
- [mcp/adk-mcp-datadog.json](./mcp/adk-mcp-datadog.json) — `DATADOG_API_KEY_CRED`, `DATADOG_APP_KEY_CRED`.
- [mcp/adk-mcp-statsig.json](./mcp/adk-mcp-statsig.json) — `STATSIG_CONSOLE_API_KEY_CRED`.
- [mcp/adk-mcp-atlassian.json](./mcp/adk-mcp-atlassian.json) — `ATLASSIAN_SITE`, `ATLASSIAN_USERNAME`, `ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN_CRED`. Confluence image upload supported.
- [mcp/adk-mcp-mixpanel.json](./mcp/adk-mcp-mixpanel.json) — OAuth on first connect.
- [mcp/adk-mcp-slack.json](./mcp/adk-mcp-slack.json) — sources `$SLACK_CREDENTIALS_FILE`.
- [mcp/adk-mcp-snowflake.json](./mcp/adk-mcp-snowflake.json) — `SNOWFLAKE_*`.
- [mcp/adk-mcp-looker.json](./mcp/adk-mcp-looker.json) — `LOOKER_*`.
- [mcp/adk-mcp-rag.json](./mcp/adk-mcp-rag.json) — optional. Loads only if `RAG_MCP_URL` set.

## User data

- `~/.config/adk/overrides.yaml` — workspaces, repos, data dictionaries, defaults, RAG config. User-edited; see [skills/adk-setup/SKILL.md](./skills/adk-setup/SKILL.md).
- `~/.config/adk/learning/decisions.jsonl` — every non-trivial fork. Append-only. Consumed by `/adk-improve`.
- `~/.config/adk/metadata/<source>.json` — auto-populated by `/adk-setup --enrich`; refreshable.

## Optional: per-repo overrides

- `<repo>/.adk/overrides.yaml` — narrows the user-level config for this repo.
- `<repo>/ai-guidelines/*.md` (or `<repo>/docs/*.md`) — repo-specific conventions adk reads at every skill run.
- `<repo>/.temp/adk/<skill>/<task>/` — gitignored task working dir for repo-bound skills (implement, document, review-on-local). See `shared/paths.md`.
- `~/.agents-devkit/<area>/<task>/` — working dir for global skills (pr-reviews, investigations, sync, …). Created by install.sh.
